rank_display.description: Reproduced exactly as published ('=8' = tied at 8th; a band such as '101-150' is kept verbatim, never converted to a single number). Null only when verification_status is 'unavailable'.

rank_kind.description: single = a sole rank; tie = a rank shared with other institutions ('=' prefix in rank_display); band = a published interval. Null only when unavailable.

score.description: Provider-published overall score, only when the provider publishes one. Never computed by PathPilot.

unavailable_reason.description: Required when verification_status is 'unavailable'; null otherwise.

ielts_reference.description: IELTS reference transcribed from the user-supplied THE 2027 ranking-table images. A compiled reference only — never an official programme requirement and never used by the eligibility engine. Null for institutions outside the THE top 100.

ielts_reference_source.description: Stated source of ielts_reference. Null when ielts_reference is null.

name_zh.description: Chinese display name, transcribed from the user-supplied THE 2027 / ARWU 2026 ranking-table images (THE preferred where the two compilations differ); verified on the institution's official site for National Taiwan University and Korea University. Absent when no verified Chinese name exists — the UI then falls back to official_name. Never invented.

official_website.description: Verified official website, only for the institutions whose programmes PathPilot covers. Null otherwise — never guessed.

provider_profiles.description: Links to the institution profile page on each provider site that ranks it (taken from the provider feeds).

attribution.description: Exact attribution notice required by the provider, when one exists. Null otherwise.

methodology_url.description: Official methodology page. Null when it could not be verified.

source_data_url.description: The provider's own data file used to verify the values. Null when no programmatic source exists.
